messages:
Ana: Quick thread — final runbook for Warehouse Workshop on Thu. 11am load-in, 1pm demo starts. Need final confirmations: swag count, demo laptop, QR cards for lead routing.
Mike: Got it. I've updated the staffing gcal slots. I'll post link.
Sam: Can we switch demo script to the shorter 7-min microtalk? Last time people wanted it tighter.
Jules: Yes. I'll trim script. Also noted shipping: FedEx pickup on Wed 4pm. Tracking: 612345678901. :truck: 
Tess: Swag inventory at HQ 2nd floor:
```
T-shirts: 180 (S:60 M:70 L:40)
Stickers: 500
Plush demos (SKU RW-PUFF-01): 48
USB demos (SKU RW-USB-LLM): 30
QR cards: 400
```
Ana: Thanks. We need 150 tees on-site. Can we cycle 30 plush for demo rotations so we always have a clean one? :thinking_face: 
Mike: Yes, packing list will include 30 plush + extra 10 for swag stash. I'll attach packing labels.
logistics-bot: Shipping label created for 3 boxes, manifest ID MF-2146-WH. ETA Wed 16:00. :white_check_mark:
Sam: For lead routing — we decided: demo QR goes to /leads/warehouse, speaker QR to /leads/speakers. Sam will own inbound triage.
Sam: I'll set up Zap: new leads -> Airtable -> Slack #leads-ops. Any CAPI needs? We should append 'event_source=warehouse_workshop' to all QR URLs.
Jules: Also creating a tiny eval survey link for quality monitoring: '1-5 relevance' + 'copy use-case'. We'll tie to outreach sequence.
Tess: Does anyone have preferred printer for the QR cards? I can do same-day at PrintCity (code RW20).
Ana: PrintCity ok. Also note: speaker submission that was tentative — @mike confirmed Jose will do the demo of prompt flows. We need his slide deck by Tue EOD.
Mike: I'll ping Jose now. Everyone — please ack when your items are done so I can lock the packing list.
Sam: Ack — I'll finish the Zap and set the webhook.
Jules: Ack — trimming script + slide notes due Tue noon.
Tess: Ack — labels printed Wed AM. Courier pick-up scheduled 15:30.
Ana: Awesome. Post-event ask: collect top 10 demo questions and flag any recurring quality regressions (tag 'event-regression') so ops can feed into Redwood Optimize.
Sam: Noted. I'll make a channel for post-event QA in #marketing-events.
Mike: Cool. Closing this thread when all acks in. :rocket:
